MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement is made between Widget Logistics Partners
LLC ("Vendor") and Northbridge Retail Group Inc. ("Client").

Effective date: March 3, 2026

Article 1. Compensation.
Client shall pay all valid invoices within fifteen (15) days of receipt.
Payment terms are net 15 days from the date of invoice.

Article 2. Term and Termination.
This Agreement may be terminated by either party upon 90 days written
notice to the other party.

Article 3. Fees.
The total contract value for the services described in Exhibit A is
$75,000.00 for the initial term.

Article 4. Liability.
Vendor's indemnification obligations under this Article shall not exceed
$25,000.00 in the aggregate.

Article 5. Choice of Law.
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California,
without regard to its conflict of laws principles.
